disposition_reason: Reports 31 elements, including lead, cadmium, total arsenic, mercury, nickel, aluminium and tin, in four laboratory-prepared cereal-based breakfast mixtures by ICP-MS.

study.design: laboratory formulation study with element analysis and dietary exposure modelling
study.origin: ingredients bought in Zlín, Czech Republic (health food store, local market; dried flowers from Czech suppliers); some flakes produced in the laboratory from purchased grains
study.method: microwave digestion HNO3/H2O2; ICP-MS (iCAP Qc, He collision cell KED)
study.lod_text: LOQ = 10 SD of blank; only Ta and U LOQ printed (0.01 ng/g)
study.qa: CRMs NIST 1568b rice flour, IAEA lichen and tea leaves; recoveries 96.2-104%
